home.title: WELCOME TO ANALOGIUM
home.subtitle: <0>ANALOGIUM is a society committed to document twisted universes, insane minds and creatures incomprehensible to the average human, as well as the souls who gave their time and sanity to develop them.</0><1>Imagine a world where the United States harbours strange creatures among its monuments; imagine a county terrorised by <2>'Doppelgängers'</2> of its inhabitants; imagine a human trapped in a machine forgotten at the bottom of the ocean. All these and more stories neatly documented in one place.</1>

origin.title: THE ORIGIN OF ANALOGIUM
origin.part1: <0><1>PART I: One-Man Show</1></0><2>Our society was born from an entity in constant pain, a human being like you or me, with a life so miserable that it is 'forgettable'; he fled for a long time in his own mind, thinking and dreaming of new worlds and alternate histories to those of our world. Eventually he made the decision to archive and share these worlds that gave him so much fear and comfort over the years. That's how <3>ANALOGIUM</3> was born... yet is not the end of our story.</2><4>Although the project filled our founding father with life, the work was too much and soon, along with private events, took its toll on his mental state. He knew he needed help, but all the time he spent locked in his own dome ended his ability to go out and talk to other humans. He became a hermit, and finding someone as fallen and broken as he was was practically impossible... until <5>she</5> arrived to his life.</4>
origin.part2: <0><1>PART II: From Bliss to Feeling Half-Death</1></0><2>'<3>Lady</3>' was everything to our creator, she was the only person in a long time to understand and heal the creator's mental wounds. He himself described her as '<4>a fallen angel</4>'...  But unfortunately nothing good can last for anyone, and one day 'Lady' evaporated from our father's life. This left him completely devastated, he didn't smile, he didn't see, he didn't move, he was just present, lifeless.</2><5>Nobody knows for sure what broke our founder's fairytale, not even the ones closest to him; the only thing he allows himself to say is: <6><7><8>It Was My Fault</8></7></6></5>
origin.part3: <0><1>PART III: Among Ashes</1></0><2>It took a long time for our founder to heal, full of empty replacements, insane acts and feelings amplified by his own pain; until in a monument of clarity, the stories that had locked him in his mind for so long resounded in his mind, and he found something that made him happy again, however temporary it seemed. He worked as hardly as he could but at last, he felt whole. Now our founding father was not alone, he managed to find a team that had the same mind as him. <3><4>He Found a Family</4></3></2>

fnaf.title: FNAF VHS
fnaf.intro: <0>FNAF VHS is a series created by Squimpus McGrimpus via YouTube. The series is made up of 2 seasons and is based on the <1>Five Nights At Freddy's</1> games (only covering the first 4 games), created by Scott Cawthon </0>
fnaf.synop: <0>Old footage from Fazbear Entertainment is starting to arrise from the shadows, and is not your avarage work guides. These held the memories and story of the 8 components of a giant curse: The Murderer, 5 Victims... and the hope of the fallen. </0>
fnaf.part1: <0><1><2>Welcome to Fazbear Entertainment's Maintenance Video Manual<3>Our protagonist finds four tapes of the company Fazbear Entertainment, these tapes being material for the workers of his chain of pizzerias Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, and his famous animatronic mascots: Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy.<4>The first tape shows a manual on how to clean the animatronics, using Freddy as an example. Step by step, it shows how to dismantle the animatronics for cleaning, until we get to the final part, where the torso is removed to reveal... blood.
fnaf.part2: <0><1><2><3>Freddy's insides</3></2></1></0><4>The second tape tests the movements Bonnie can perform, in order to prevent any failure of her metallic joints. However, halfway through the tests Bonnie begins to act peculiarly, first remaining static, then seeking refuge in the shadows, until finally she attacks the camera and cuts the video.</4><5>After a brief static, a mysterious gift appears in front of the camera, from the first victim and the one who plans to end it all once and for all: <6>The Puppet</6>.</5><7>The third tape prepares Chica to test her sound detection and see if everything works as it should... At this point it should come as no surprise that something weird ends up happening with Chica, but now it's something more “human”... <8>She speaks directly to the camera.</8></7>
fnaf.part3: <0>THIS MUSIC MAKES ME FEEL BETTER.</0><1>IT MAKES ME THINK ABOUT BIRDS.<2>I LIKE BIRDS.<3>THEY ARE PRETTY.</1><4>ONE TIME, I SAW A BIRD SLEEPING IN THE SNOW.<5>THAT'S WHAT BAD DREAMS ARE ABOUT.</4><6>I FEEL LIKE I'M SLEEPING IN SNOW.<7>AND I CAN'T GET UP.<8>IT'S TOO COLD FOR ME TO DO THAT.</6><9>THINGS DON'T BREATHE WHEN THEY SLEEP IN SNOW.<10>I CAN'T BREATHE.</9><11>I CAN'T BREATHE.</11>
fnaf.part4: <0>The last tape shows a short prologue of Foxy the Pirate's show, where he invites the kids to show up in 3 minutes or there will be serious consequences, like sending Freddy and the rest of the crew to David Jones' Locker, or asking for a raise (I think that joke was more aimed at the parents)... until he presents the silhouette of 5 kids, of which one disappears. The video now repeats without music, and near the end the audio cuts out completely, being replaced with an alarm.</0><1>Another of the children disappears, and the video repeats a third time, now with a synthetic voice demanding that we stop watching the tape. The video cuts in half and the last remaining children disappear, and from the shadows...<2>“he” appears</2>.</1><3>WHAT'S THE MATTER, FOXY?<4>I THOUGHT YOU WANTED AN AUDIENCE</3><5>It would seem that this is the end, but one last gift is given to our protagonist... <6>a fifth tape</6> that shows in depth everything that has happened in this chain of pizzerias, and how everything is going to end.</5><7>A familiar entity starts talking to whoever is watching the tape, explaining that, since always, the place was a dangerous place thanks to the Spring-Lock suits, going through the accident that killed our brother and that now, because of our father, everything is even worse. Father? Brother? Who is this entity talking to? To our protagonist, <8>Michael Afton</8>.</7><9>His brother, Joseph (Golden Freddy), would die in an accident at Fredbear's Family Dinner because of Michael, where his head would be crushed by Fredbear's jaws; his father, William Afton (the Purple Guy), would go mad because of this and murder 5 children on the establishments, with Puppet's soul being the first victim. She would since help the others by possessing the costumes of the other animatronics, and plotting revenge against William, who despite dying inside a Spring-Lock suit, his soul is still trapped with the others. Now with Micheal's help, a happy ending looks possible.</9><10>And how? We still need to wait for <11>the Horror Attraction</11>.</10>
fnaf.part5: <0>This ends the first act, where Puppet presents Michael with the strategy to end the curse of the pizzerias. But we are far from the end: 7 new tapes enter the formula.</0><1><2><3>Welcome to your new job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza!</3></2></1><4>The sixth tape is a training video for the night security guards, introducing the employees to the tools they will use, such as the camera system, the door controls, the danger posed by the animatronics, and a strange golden rabbit who wants to <5>talk to his boy</5>. At certain points in the film, certain distortions show William in the shadows, trying to get closer to Michael, even giving him indications of where he is trapped.</4><6>The seventh film returns with the testing of the animatronics, now with the Toy models and their new facial recognition technology. Whoever is recording the test shows various photos to the robot, some containing innocent people and others containing people with criminal records; should the latter appear the animatronic will emit a subtle alarm. It sounds simple, and it is simple... until one last photo over-alarms the animatronic, who attacks the employee (who fortunately saved himself). But why, instead of alarming, did it attack? Toy Bonnie didn't recognise a criminal, it recognised <7><8>THE CRIMINAL</8></7>.</6>
fnaf.part6: <0><1><2><3>CRIMINAL</3></2></1></0><4>The eighth tape, rather than work footage, is a security camera recording, capturing Chica and Bonnie leaving the stage. As the two meet between the tables, they start talking to each other about who might be in the office now, at which point Chica mentions that if it was “him” who is hiding, he should be sorry for what he did to her <5>good brother</5>; Bonnie starts to cry and is grateful that his sister doesn't know exactly what is going on. The two separate and the song <6>Lullaby of The Leaves</6> begins to play on stage.<7>This particular film is the rawest of the whole collection, because it reminds us that, inside those killer pets, behind all the curse of the establishment... <8>there are only children waiting to go home.</8></4><9>The ninth tape is a communiqué to the employees of Fredbear's Family Dinner, notifying them of the changes to be made to the pizzeria after the accident that killed Joseph, including the removal of Spring-Lock technology, and the replacement of Springbonnie and Fredbear with the foursome we all know best. Fazbear Entertainment's management had as a priority the public reaction and the constant questions that would come after these changes, however they already had a solution for that: <10>deny <11>everything</11></10>.</9>
fnaf.part7: <0>i don't exist?</0><1>you said you were sorry<2>and that you loved me</1><3>but i know you're lying<4>you don't love me<5>that's what you always said</3><6>i don't love you either<7>and i'll take you with me</6><8>so you'll know how it feels<9>to stop existing</8>
fnaf.part8: <0>The tenth tape shows a cartoon based on the mascots of the pizzeria, and what they do after closing the place. This particular episode shows the gang getting ready for pizza for dinner, until they notice something strange in the dining room: there are 6 chairs and only 4 people. Freddy doesn't pay much attention to that and says it must be a “strange coincidence”; Chica, not entirely convinced, starts looking through boxes for something that shows the opposite of what Freddy said, until she finds a photograph of the band with two silhouettes of a rabbit and a bear. Strange sounds lead her to the kitchen, where she finds Golden Freddy who wants to talk to all of them: Joseph still doesn't trust his brother, he still hates him for everything that happened in '83; he can't save them, they would never go to heaven.</0>
fnaf.part9: <0><1><2>we're never getting out</2></1></0><3>The penultimate tape is a recording of William Afton himself, where he confesses to the murder of “The 5 Missing Childrens of Freddy's”, and delves into his motives and modus operandi. William was left with the anger of having lost his little Joseph to a son he always hated, and to free himself from all that torment he decided to drown himself with other children who were just like Michael in his eyes: complete brats.<4>After confessing, William gives a final warning to whoever is listening to the tape: he checks the place where he hid the tape every day to see if it has moved, even if it is millimetres apart. So you'd better put the tape down Michael, <5>and start running</5>.</3><6>The final tape is a series of voice recordings of William after he died inside the Springbonnie suit, and how he was waiting for Michael from 1993 to 2008, from Freddy Fazbear's Pizza to Fazbear's Fright: <7>The Horror Attraction</7>. It's now or never, Michael is on the premises along with Puppet, the souls of the children, and his own father, ready to end this curse once and for all.</6><8>To Nicole Morales, Lucas and Angie Collins, and Benjamin Nelson: I hope your souls find the freedom that has been denied to you for so many years.<9>To Charlie Emily: I hope you rest in the knowledge of all you did for those grateful children, they would still be there if it wasn't for your help.<10>To Michael and Joseph Afton: I hope you both find the “sorry” you have been missing, that you will find peace in God's kingdom.<11>To William Afton: <12>I hope you <13>die in a fire</13>.</12></8>
fnaf.note: <0>MESSAGE FROM OUR FATHER:<1>The ANALOGIUM Society does not condone Grooming or any similar sin. In no other universe have we seen anything as horrendous as this kind of inhumane behaviour. If you have committed or are committing these acts, we wish you luck in trying to enter Hell.<2>PEOPLE LIKE YOU DESERVE A WORSE PUNISHMENT.</0>

mythos.title: THE MONUMENT MYTHOS
mythos.intro: <0>The Monument Mythos is a tale developed by MISTER MANTICORE (Alex Casanas) via YouTube. The series have 3 seasons and a Spin-Off known as <1>THE NIXONVERSE</1>.</0>
mythos.synop: <0>SYNOPSIS</0><1>The series chronicles the strange happenings that America doesn't usually talk about, or do you think an entire government would chatter about a monster inside the Statue of Liberty like it's nothing?<2>Some similar things happen all over the country (and somewhere in Egypt), like an entire island that actively sprawls, a parallel dimension, an “angel” inside the Air-Force One and a crystal as sharp as it is mysterious.</1>

nixon.title: THE NIXONVERSE
nixon.intro: <0>THE NIXONVERSE is a tale developed by MISTER MANTICORE (Alex Casanas) via YouTube. The series is a Spin-Off of his main story, <1>THE MONUMENT MYTHOS</1>.</0>
nixon.synop: <0>The series take place after the events of the second season of MONUMENT MYTHOS, in a different universe with a familiar form; the story connects four entities very similar and powerful: the Son, the Knight, the Queen and... <1>God</1>. With these entities, there are some eyes that glow more than others, those being from Alice Avenue, Ed Dwight, and the egocentric self of the United States, always obsessed with power.</0>
nixon.part1: <0><1><2>Faster than an airplane! More powerful than a locomotive! Impervious to bullets! Up in the sky, look! It's a bird! It's a plane! It's--</2></1></0><3>Our story begins with <4>The Last Son</4>, a real superhero who is always there to save us all, and yet some people are in constant fear that he will rebel against us and conquer us.</3><5>Actually, he is not our only hero, there is another one baptized <6>The D-Day Knight</6>, the one who saved the US Army on the battlefield that day in 1944. He gave us all hope and faith from his intervention in Normandy, and no one more than Alice Avenue had great respect and affection for him. During D-Day, the Knight lost something that will prove very interesting later on, he lost his helmet.</5>
nixon.part2: <0><1><2><3>D-Day Knight's Helmet</3></2></1></0><4>That's the beginning of our planet, but what if we go up? Somewhere like... <5>the Moon.</5></4><6>The first mission to land humans on the Moon was not as normal as you might think, because Ed Dwight (the first man on the Moon) and his team found the <7>Queen of the Lunarians</7>, and witnessed the first recorded words on our natural satellite. The queen prophesied a Great Division on Earth, since humans did not know how to live, how to love, how to fly... Unfortunately, a small bloodstain covered the moment, because after ordering Ed to shoot her, John Glenn was <8>evicted from reality</8>.</6>
nixon.part3: <0><1><2><3>John Glenn's cause of death: a Lunarian encounter</3></2></1></0><4>It's at this very moment that Ed Dwight would have a very interesting talk with <5>someone special,</5> but we'll come back to that later. Now that we know our protagonists, we can move on to our antagonist: United States.</4><6><7>After interfering in the Korean War, THE LAST SON returned to his fortress in Alaska. <8>Nuclear missiles followed him home.</8></7></6><9>After the Apollo 11 mission revealed the properties of the Lunarian anatomy, the United States wasted no time in sending Apollo 12 to bring back the perfect ingredient to fulfil the devious plan: a Lunarian Eye. Phase one was completed, but something was still missing... or rather, somebody. An eye of an alien race and the equivalent of Superman, why would the proclaimed land of freedom want these elements? Easy, <10>to create their own Jesus</10>.</9><11>After brainwashing the Last Son, the United States would bring a distorted version of peace during the Vietnam War, now called Bethlenam or “The First Saved State”; this fake treaty was referred to as The Peace Equation.</11><12><13><14><15>OUR FREEDOM ᐳ YOUR FREEDOM<16>OUR CHRIST ᐳ YOUR CHRIST<17>= WORLD PEACE</15></14></13></12><18>In a turn of events, the Last Son opened his eyes (well... his one eye), and realized all the horrifying acts he had committed under the mantle of the Messiah. Devastated by this, he fled to the ocean of his former home, Dark Alaska, and sought a refuge isolated from man, something that would remind him of his childhood, something like... a <19>House in the Ocean</19>.</18><20>Fate is very funny, because some time later the Last Son would have an encounter with a ship of a race we know very well, the Lunarians come to fulfil a prophecy: bring their King back home. <21>The Crescent King was born.</21></20>
nixon.part4: <0><1><2><3>Evolution of the Last Son</3></2></1></0><4>Slowly, the Lunarians began to take control of America, not only by creating “vessels for the king's essence”, but also by attacking the human culture, starting with language. No one understood their own thoughts, so they had to accept the Lunarian culture by force in order to survive. However, in the midst of all this storm, a familiar voice returned to bring faith to the human race... Alice Avenue broadcasted over the radio the story of the Last Son.</4><5>The Last Son was a young man like you and me, with parents who were cutthroats and classmates who were worse. The boy was always alone when he went to school, and always in those moments driving towards his destiny, he doubted his role in the universe; he always thought that he had to help everyone around him, and that he had to win at any cost. One day in the midst of his thoughts, the young man was involved in a car crash; still strong enough to move, he got out of his car and approached the dying man with whom he had collided, a familiar face from another universe... <6>James Dean</6>.</5><7>“You won, little bastard... you won...”, this were the last words of the man who in this universe, lost. The Last Son was devastated and could not hold back his tears, and from the pain and exhaustion caused by the accident, he fainted. He woke up in a strange dream, where he found himself on a cliff with a vehicle behind him, which was driving at high speed. He, to avoid the impact, jumped into the void, and began to believe more and more that he could fly, that he could beat death... he did it. The young man began to fly high, faster than an airplane. It was right here that he woke up and flew as far away as possible from the scene of the accident. He kept on believing, and kept on winning at any cost in order to save everyone.</7><8>Alice not only prayed that the Crescent King would remember the hero he was before America captured him, she also hoped that the Knight would return to save us all again. He listened to her words and executed a desperate plan to make the humanity of the Last Son wake up again: throw Alice off the top of the Chrysler Building hoping that he would rescue her... <9>that never happened</9>.</8>
nixon.part5: <0><1><2><3>Alice Avenue's last moments of life</3></2></1></0><4>After the Knight's plan failed in every way, the Lunarians continued their invasion, brainwashing and altering human brains in major cities such as New York. It's at this point that the Knight would compose a message apologizing for what happened to Alice, and that she was still alive...</4><5><6><7>IN MY WORLD, STATUES HELD SOULS</7></6></5><8>Something still left the Knight unsatisfied, something made him feel hollow, so to try to redeem himself he removed the head of the Alice Avenue memorial statue and wear it as if it were his old helmet; even though he had only worn it for a day something in him changed, the only thing that could be seen was his eye, full of anger... <9><10>Grief can make you a monster</10></9>.</8><11>This precise moment is where Apollo 11 comes back to play a vital role, so we'll have to go back in time a bit, and put ourselves in Ed Dwight's spacesuit again. His body was found on the moon, and it was determined that his death was caused by his own weapon; next to him was a tape which would be referred to as “THE MOON GOD”. On this tape is revealed the conversation Ed had with that someone special who has been hidden for quite some time, the God behind the beings that are causing so much damage right now... <12>Richard Nixon</12>.</11>
nixon.part6: <0><1><2><3>Photograph of God<4>By Ed Dwight</3></2></1></0><5><6>Note: The following audio does not feature the voice of Ed Dwight.</6></5>
nixon.part7: <0>Nixon explains in this tape that he managed to escape from the Horned Serpent during the Great Division, and that he ended up on the moon of this new universe. He had doubts about whether people would accept him, so he created three extensions of himself to run a little experiment, which is how The Son, The Knight and The Queen were born. All three went somewhat insane, and Nixon concluded that he couldn't risk entering an unfriendly planet. Besides, he already knew that the Son would become King of the Lunarians, and that if he didn't stop it, he would become exceedingly powerful.</0><1><2>“I am sorry, Mr Dwight. No human was ever meant to hear what I have said.”</2></1><3>Back on our planet, the Queen of the Lunarians tries to talk to the Knight telepathically, trying to convince him to leave Earth and join the kingdom as Prince, to bring a place of harmony, to repair the peace equation, so that he can return to his old self. However, the Knight, amidst all the anger he has, still fulfils the words of Alice Avenue: “At all times, in all places, the Knight can SAVE US”, and unleashes a final attack that would not only destroy him, the Queen and the Lunarians, but also restore human culture within 9 months: <4>ALCATRAZ CHECKMATE</4>.</3><5>However, there is still the King, who has finally become aware of all he has done, and breaks down in tears once again. Grief made him a monster, he will not stop crying, he does not want to live, but in that instant, he mutates again, assimilating a very familiar form to the Knight's helmet, becoming what Nixon feared he would become... <6><7>THE HORNED SERPENT LIVES.</7></6></5>
nixon.part8: <0><1><2><3><4>THE HORNED SERPENT LIVES</4></3></2></1></0><5>Nixon must act fast, he can't let it all end like his own world ended, so he decided to render the King, the Knight, the Queen, and himself as fiction, so no one will believe in the Crescent King and so he loses his powers. That's how this whole world became a comic book called “The Nixonverse”, with an endearing story made by a certain “Mister Manticore” and beautiful illustrations made by... <6>Ed Dwight?</6></5><7>Compared to Nixon, Ed Dwight was twice the God he was, Nixon was just one of many survivors who erased the past, to run from the present. Ed was everything Nixon wasn't, someone bold, kind and good. He never went to the moon, let alone talked to a God, he is today in our world creating monuments... <8>Ed Dwight preserves the past.</8></7>
